All this snow, wind, and freezing temperatures have started the creation of ice volcanoes along the shoreline of Lake Ontario. (DO NOT walk out on the ice shelf!!)
Cobourg and Wicklow, Ontario

Walked a mile down the beach looking at all the ice volcanos, pictures never really capture the size of the geysers. Some were the normal cone shape but most formed in fissures when the front face of the ice breaks off and when these crevasses form right the waves rush through them and shoot out top
Ice ice baby…ice formation and volcanoes on Lake Ontario
Ever hear of an "ice volcano"? This formation happened along the shoreline of Lake Ontario today. What is it? How does it form? Find out here! youtu.be/L6nfafvID8g?...

Pulling from the Archives again, We have an interesting structure created by waves on the Great Lakes, This photo was taken on Lake Superior. I believe these are called Ice Volcanoes. Enjoy! #icevolcano
It looks like the ice is breaking up and floating off into the water
Formation of ice volcanoes along the shoreline of Lake Ontario. #PrequileProvincialPark #Ontario #Canada

We spotted “ice volcanoes” on Lake Erie while scouting our upcoming projects in partnership with Cradle Beach. While fascinating to see, these can be unstable with hidden holes and frigid cold-water underneath, so it’s best to admire from a safe distance.
